description: Executable Candidate reproduction of MiaAI-Lab's physically tested one-DGX-Spark DeepSeek V4 Flash profile: native compact NVFP4 KV, 384K single-request context, DSpark K5, CUDA graphs through 24 rows, and 0.94 memory utilization. GB10 memory correction: GPU utilization 0.94 → 0.85. Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint. This deviates from the upstream memory profile to avoid unified-memory thrashing; context and other kit flags are retained with a smaller KV pool. GB10 fit: GPU utilization 0.85 → 0.83 so the declared peak plus the 6 GB OS floor fits a Spark's idle available memory.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 Mia SparkInfer single Spark
